service.description: The caller clocks in or out, now (the server's time), for their own employment (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE): the worker is the session's and never a parameter; partyRelationshipId only chooses among the caller's own current employments (another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), and with none named their only one with clocking on is used. The employment must have clocking on (CLOCKING_OFF); one clocking for several employers names it (EMPLOYMENT_REQUIRED). The direction is the one asked (directionEnumId AtdIn or AtdOut), else the other of the caller's state; clocking in while in (ALREADY_IN) or out while out (NOT_IN) is refused. The punch counts on the day of the employment's working schedule zone (an out-punch on the day of the in-punch it closes). A retry with the same operationKey answers the first punch (repeated).

The caller's own clock (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; no party parameter): each of their current employments with its employer, whether clocking is on, whether they are clocked in and since when, the last punch, today's time and the action the clock offers; clocking is true when any employment has it on. Nothing for a caller without self-service.

Whether the caller clocks for a current employment of their own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE and a person; no party parameter): the condition-service of the quick create Clock in, which the shell asks on each page load. Answers false for anyone else.

An employment's clocking set by an HR editor of the employer (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT; another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), with the reason kept by the field's audit row: clockingEnabled Y (it clocks) or N (it does not), each an exception to the employer's default (its PartySetting PeopleClocking), or empty to follow that default (CLOCKING_INVALID otherwise). Answers whether it clocks now, its own setting and the employer's default. Turning it off keeps every punch.

parameter.name: clockingEnabled
parameter.description: Y, N, or empty to follow the employer's default

parameter.name: clockingSetting
parameter.description: Its own setting, Y or N, or none when it follows the employer

service.description: Who clocks: the current employments of the employers an HR reader reads (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW; one employer when organizationPartyId names it, ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope) that clock, by their own setting or the employer's default, and those set apart from it, each with the person, the employer, whether it clocks (clockingEnabled), its own setting (clockingSetting Y, N or none) and the employer's default, how in words, whether they are clocked in now and whether the caller may change it. Paged.

The attendance days the caller reads: their own (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE; mine for those alone), their live reports' at the line's employers (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW) and an HR reader's employers' (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW); with toDecide, the days whose waiting correction the caller decides now (PEOPLE_REQUEST_APPROVE). Narrowed to a person, an employer, an employment, days fromDate through thruDate and exceptionsOnly (a missing or repeated punch not corrected, or a correction asked). Newest first, paged (an export, pageNoLimit, every row up to 5000); each with the person, employer, day, first in and last out (an overnight shift's out marked +1), punches, time worked, what is missing in words, state, whether the caller decides it and whether they may correct it. Refuses a caller with none of the four permissions (PERMISSION_DENIED).

An attendance day the caller reads (the person, their manager at the employer, HR of the employer, an approver of its correction; another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): the day as find#Attendance shows it, its raw punches (direction, time, source, the source system and its key), its corrections (intervals, time, reason, who asked, state and approval) and what the caller may do: canCorrect (the person, their manager or an HR editor, while no correction waits), canDecide (an approver of the step waiting), canWithdraw (the person or who asked, while it waits).

A correction of an employment's day asked: the day (attendanceDayId, or partyRelationshipId and attendanceDate for a day with no punch), the intervals worked (intervals, a list of {fromTime, thruTime} as HH:mm of the day, a thru at or before the from ending the next day; or fromTime and thruTime with fromTime2 and thruTime2) and the reason. Asked by the person (PEOPLE_SELF_SERVICE), their manager at the employer (PEOPLE_TEAM_VIEW) or an HR editor of the employer; another reader is refused (PERMISSION_DENIED), another day as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Sent for a People approval of kind PakAttendance (the PeopleAttendanceApproval topic to the first step's approvers; the person's manager unless a rule says otherwise; never the requester or the person). The punches are kept as they are. Refuses: DATE_REQUIRED, DATE_FUTURE, DATE_OUTSIDE, REASON_REQUIRED, INTERVALS_REQUIRED, TIME_INVALID, INTERVALS_OVERLAP, CORRECTION_PENDING (one waits for the day). A retry with the same operationKey answers the first (repeated).

An attendance correction decided, under its employment's lock. approve or refuse: the step waiting, through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision at the correction's revision (sourceRevision from a notice); the last approval makes it the day's attendance (the day corrected, its time the correction's; the punches unchanged); a refusal needs a reason. withdraw: the person or who asked, while it waits (its approval superseded). One who reads nothing of it is answered as for a missing one (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A decision retried answers the first (repeated). Refuses: DECISION_INVALID, NOT_YOURS, NOT_PENDING and record#Decision's refusals (NOT_APPROVER, SELF_APPROVAL, ALREADY_DECIDED, SOURCE_CHANGED, REASON_REQUIRED).

The PeopleAttendanceApproval topic's approve service, which approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user deciding the notice: decide#Correction at the correction and revision in the message (a notice of an earlier revision is refused); refuses a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID).

The PeopleAttendanceApproval topic's refuse service, with the reason (the topic requires one): as approve#Correction, the correction refused (the day keeps its punches' time, or an earlier approved correction's).

A device file of attendance events for an employer read and previewed (TimeImport's first step): the caller holds PEOPLE_IMPORT, PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED) and edits the employer (ORGANIZATION_DENIED). The file (importFile, or importText) is delimited text (a comma, a semicolon or delimiter tab) with a header line and at most 5000 rows and 1 MiB; its columns are named by workerColumn (worker), timeColumn (time), directionColumn (direction), keyColumn (id, the event's own key, optional) and deviceColumn (device, optional). A worker is named by People's person id (workerIdKind partyId) or work email (workEmail); a time is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm[:ss] in timeZone (or with its offset); a direction is in or out. Each row is resolved to the worker's employment by the employer at that time and its source key (the employer, the source system and the event's key, else the worker, instant and direction) and kept with its outcome: ready, known (recorded already), duplicate (repeated in the file) or refused with its reason (WORKER_UNKNOWN, WORKER_AMBIGUOUS, NOT_EMPLOYED, EMPLOYMENT_AMBIGUOUS, TIME_INVALID, TIME_FUTURE, DIRECTION_INVALID, ROW_INVALID). Nothing is recorded. Refuses the file: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, SOURCE_REQUIRED, ZONE_INVALID, WORKER_KIND_INVALID, FILE_REQUIRED, FILE_TOO_LARGE, FILE_UNREADABLE, COLUMN_MISSING.

A previewed attendance import recorded (TimeImport's second step), by the same permissions and employer as its preview (another import is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): its ready rows in time order by employment, each in its own transaction as a raw punch (AtsImport, the source system and the event's key) on its employment's day; a source key recorded by then is skipped, a row that fails is named with its reason and the rest go on. It approves nothing. An import recorded already answers as it ended (repeated).

An attendance import an HR reader of its employer reads (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW; another is refused as missing, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE): the file, employer, source system, zone, state, counts, who read it and when, whether the caller may import it now, and its rows (all, an outcome, or problems: refused and failed), each with the line, what it named (worker, person, time, direction, key, device) and its outcome with its reason.

The attendance imports of the employers an HR reader reads (PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and People's scope), newest first, as summaries: the file's name, the employer, previewed or imported, the rows read, imported, skipped and refused, who read or recorded it and when, and the parameters that open it in TimeImport. None otherwise.
